SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS d, status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS dist_ids
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-30' AND DATE '2025-12-02'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH o AS (
  SELECT *, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS od
  FROM fact_web_order
),
t AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.receipt_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE p.category = 'ZZ Test' OR s.store_id = 999
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS non_cancelled,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS dist_ids,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.receipt_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS utc_date_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing
FROM o LEFT JOIN t ON t.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
WHERE o.od = DATE '2025-12-01' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
